mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM golf.payment WHERE payment_type = 'PAYMENT' AND payment_status IN ('PAID', 'SUCCEEDED', 'REFUNDED') AND completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM golf.payment WHERE (payment_type = 'PAYMENT' AND payment_status = 'REFUNDED' AND refunded_at >= #{from} AND refunded_at < #{to}) OR (payment_type = 'REFUND' AND payment_status IN ('PAID', 'SUCCEEDED', 'REFUNDED') AND completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{to})
